description: Error message format for dependency validation failures
purpose: Provide clear, actionable error messages when deletion is blocked due to dependencies

category_with_devices.title: Category In Use - Cannot Delete
category_with_devices.detail_template:
Category '{categoryName}' cannot be deleted because it has {count} device(s) assigned.

Dependent devices:
  - {hostname1} (uuid: {uuid1})
  - {hostname2} (uuid: {uuid2})
  ... (showing first 10 of {total})

Resolution options:
  1. Reassign devices to another category before deleting
  2. Delete the dependent devices first
  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan device references)

example.title: Category In Use - Cannot Delete
example.detail:
Category 'default' cannot be deleted because it has 3 device(s) assigned.

Dependent devices:
  - node01 (uuid: abc-123)
  - node02 (uuid: def-456)
  - node03 (uuid: ghi-789)

Resolution options:
  1. Reassign devices to another category before deleting
  2. Delete the dependent devices first
  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan device references)

image_with_categories.title: Software Image In Use - Cannot Delete
image_with_categories.detail_template:
Software Image '{imageName}' cannot be deleted because it has {count} categor(ies) assigned.

Dependent categories:
  - {name1} (uuid: {uuid1})
  - {name2} (uuid: {uuid2})
  ... (showing first 10 of {total})

Resolution options:
  1. Update categories to use a different software image before deleting
  2. Delete the dependent categories first (after removing their devices)
  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan category references)

example.title: Software Image In Use - Cannot Delete
example.detail:
Software Image 'Rocky-8.10-NVIDIA-GPU-545' cannot be deleted because it has 2 categor(ies) assigned.

Dependent categories:
  - default (uuid: abc-123)
  - compute (uuid: def-456)

Resolution options:
  1. Update categories to use a different software image before deleting
  2. Delete the dependent categories first (after removing their devices)
  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan category references)

force_deletion_category.title: Force Deletion Warning
force_deletion_category.detail_template:
Category '{categoryName}' is being deleted with force=true. This may create orphaned references in dependent resources.

Potential Impact:
  - Devices assigned to this category will have invalid category references
  - Device provisioning may fail until devices are reassigned to a valid category

This operation cannot be undone.

example.title: Force Deletion Warning
example.detail:
Category 'default' is being deleted with force=true. This may create orphaned references in dependent resources.

Potential Impact:
  - Devices assigned to this category will have invalid category references
  - Device provisioning may fail until devices are reassigned to a valid category

This operation cannot be undone.

force_deletion_image.title: Force Deletion Warning
force_deletion_image.detail_template:
Software Image '{imageName}' is being deleted with force=true. This may create orphaned references in dependent resources.

Potential Impact:
  - Categories using this image will have invalid software image references
  - Device provisioning may fail for affected categories

This operation cannot be undone.

example.title: Force Deletion Warning
example.detail:
Software Image 'Rocky-8.10' is being deleted with force=true. This may create orphaned references in dependent resources.

Potential Impact:
  - Categories using this image will have invalid software image references
  - Device provisioning may fail for affected categories

This operation cannot be undone.

dependency_check_failed.title: Dependency Check Failed
dependency_check_failed.detail_template:
Unable to verify dependencies for {resourceType} '{resourceName}' due to API error: {errorMessage}

You can proceed with deletion by setting 'force = true', but this may create orphaned references if dependencies exist.

example.title: Dependency Check Failed
example.detail:
Unable to verify dependencies for Category 'default' due to API error: request timeout after 5 seconds

You can proceed with deletion by setting 'force = true', but this may create orphaned references if dependencies exist.

terraform_diagnostic_format.description: Error format for Terraform provider diagnostics

structure.summary: Brief title (e.g., 'Category In Use - Cannot Delete')
structure.detail: Full error message with context and resolution options

example_usage.go_code:
resp.Diagnostics.AddError(
    "Category In Use - Cannot Delete",
    fmt.Sprintf(
        "Category '%s' cannot be deleted because it has %d device(s) assigned.\n\n" +
        "Dependent devices:\n%s\n\n" +
        "Resolution options:\n" +
        "  1. Reassign devices to another category before deleting\n" +
        "  2. Delete the dependent devices first\n" +
        "  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan device references)",
        categoryName,
        len(devices),
        formatDeviceList(devices),
    ),
)

implementation_notes: Always include resource name and count in error messages
List dependent resource identifiers (max 10, then truncate)
Provide 3 resolution options: reassign, delete dependencies, or force delete
Use Warning severity for force deletion (not Error)
Use Error severity for blocked deletion due to dependencies
Include 'This operation cannot be undone' for force deletions
Format consistently: title on first line, blank line, detail with sections
